descriptions.value: The CoE SDO download handler for flexible-length objects (VISIBLE_STRING, OCTET_STRING, and similar) does not check that the master-declared transfer size fits within the object before writing. Two distinct writes are affected: the VISIBLE_STRING zero-padding memset and the first-frame copy into the object buffer.

assertions.title: CoE SDO Download Bounds Check Failures on Flexible-Length Objects

title: CoE SDO Download Bounds Check Failures on Flexible-Length Objects

descriptions.value: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
